# T23 -- Lung-Region Attention Module on ResNet50 -- Module Card

**Backbone:** ResNet50 (timm, ImageNet-pretrained). **Draft auto-generated by S18 -- review before treating as final.**

## 1. Selected hyperparameters

- `lambda_att*` = 1.0 (S9; largest lambda_att whose val macro-F1 is within 0.5pp of lam_att_0.0; ties -> higher val ILAR)
- `lambda_bg*` = 1.0 (S11; largest lambda_bg whose val macro-F1 is within 0.5pp of lam_bg_0.0 (plain A2); ties -> higher val ILAR)
- `reduction` = 8 -> +524,801 params (+2.23% of ResNet50's 23,516,228)

- **[FAIL]** A1_attention_matches_lung_mask: 0.7779 (target: Attention-Dice >= 0.80 on test)
- **[PASS]** A2_evidence_inside_lung_up: 0.0754 (target: delta Grad-CAM EIL (post-gate) >= +0.05)
- **[PASS]** A3_mechanism_is_real: 0.0206 (target: delta Grad-CAM EIL (pre-gate) > 0)

**ResNet50's winner: A3_multiply**

## 7. Reproducibility notes

- Data pipeline `t23-ramcache-freshloader-v1`: RAM-cached inputs (bit-identical to disk), a fresh seeded train loader per run, so each arm is reproducible regardless of which session it ran in.
- Checkpoints (`.pt`) are not committed -- record their Kaggle Dataset / Drive URLs here.
